name: API 助手
description: 分析第三方 AI API 文档并生成调用方案。

name: 品牌识别系统
description: 梳理品牌策略、视觉识别并生成品牌延展物料。
entryPrompt: 请按品牌识别系统流程开始信息收集。

name: Modular Watercolor Collage
description: 将任意主题或参考图转化为同一张手工纸上的模块化水彩分区画面；有参考图时保留真实主体、视角、空间关系、构图动线、色彩比例和氛围，再以不规则矩形颜料色域与止水毛边完成水彩化。
planningGuidance: Use for any subject rendered as irregular rectangular watercolor fields painted directly on one continuous handmade-paper surface. Default to 9:16 unless the user requests another ratio. Keep the modular silhouette narrow, occupying roughly 38%-52% of the canvas width and 68%-78% of its height, with at least about 14% clear paper on both sides and about 10% above and below. Never invent, retrieve, attach, or request a reference image when the user did not supply one. Without references, retain every shared constraint and require the existing 7-10-field broken vertical tower, pigment stopping edges, no three fields side by side, and at most two short aligned edge pairs. With references, add fidelity rules without removing the shared field-count, randomness, one-paper, material, whitespace, typography, or negative constraints: inspect the actual pixels, use one primary composition reference, classify hard anchors, supporting elements, and dispensable detail, preserve viewpoint, spatial relationships, composition paths, palette proportions, light, and mood, and map roughly 70% of the reference across 3-4 adjacent main fields plus 3-5 supporting fields. Preserve the full horizontal field of view when fitting a shorter reference into 9:16. Never substitute a text summary for the actual reference image, randomly redistribute anchors, invent major objects, or add text when the reference has none. Reject independent cards, paper depth, neat grids, repeated columns, equal gaps, photo-filter results, or one seamless full-page painting. Prefer gc-minimal-zine-poster-v0-1 for sparse zine posters and magazine-poster for publication-led editorial collages.
generationContract: Return a compact four-paragraph plain-text image prompt for the user's requested ratio or a 9:16 default. Require the full modular silhouette to occupy roughly 38%-52% of the canvas width and 68%-78% of its height, keeping at least about 14% clear paper on both sides and about 10% above and below; no pigment field or crossing detail may touch or nearly touch a canvas edge. Never create, attach, or request a reference image when none was supplied, and never relax the shared modular, one-paper, pigment-edge, whitespace, typography, or negative constraints in either mode. Without references, require 7-10 unequal rectangular pigment fields painted on one continuous paper surface that fills the canvas edge to edge, 1-2 tall main fields, no three fields side by side, no repeated widths or equal gaps, two pronounced side protrusions, one isolated accent, at most two aligned edge pairs, a jagged open outer silhouette, watercolor stopping edges, and no more than about 20% subject crossing across 1-2 seams. Whenever references exist, keep the actual primary reference image attached to the image-generation request; do not replace it with text-only analysis. Preserve the primary reference's subject, viewpoint, spatial relationships, composition paths, hard-anchor positions, palette proportions, value hierarchy, light, and mood; preserve the full horizontal field of view without cropping or stretching; map roughly 70% of its information continuously across 3-4 offset main fields and use 3-5 supporting fields only for reference-derived detail, material, and palette echoes. Keep 7-9 unequal reference-mode fields, composition paths crossing at most 3 seams, directional elements at most 2, compact anchors mostly intact, and no text unless supplied or requested. Explicitly forbid a visible outer sheet edge or sheet shadow, invented major objects, redistributed anchors, photo-filter results, independent cards, white card bases, stacked or torn paper, thickness, shadows, neat grids, repeated columns, enclosing rectangles, watermarks, and platform marks; then generate and inspect the image.

name: Minimal Zine Poster
description: 将主题、句子、物件、情绪、文章构想或参考图转化为留白充足、旧纸印刷质感的日式或韩式极简 ZINE 编辑海报，并直接生成图片。
planningGuidance: Use for sparse Japanese or Korean indie zine posters with aged paper, large negative space, experimental small typography, print defects, and one saturated color anchor. Do not select it from the generic word poster alone. Prefer magazine-poster for conventional magazine covers, fashion editorials, publication-led layouts, or dense collage posters.
generationContract: Return a compact four-paragraph plain-text image prompt following the selected zine recipe, using a supported vertical 2:3 canvas, then generate the image. Preserve the user's literal copy when supplied and keep the result sparse, paper-like, non-commercial, and visibly anchored by one saturated hue.

name: Logo 与品牌
description: 收集品牌信息并生成 Logo 与基础视觉方向。
entryPrompt: 请按 Logo 与品牌流程开始信息收集。

name: 杂志封面与编辑海报
description: 设计高级杂志封面、期刊主视觉、文字主导的文化海报、报纸或杂志排版语言海报、拼贴艺术编辑海报，并生成 JSON 文本形式的生图提示词。
planningGuidance: Use for magazine covers and editorial posters, including typography-led cultural posters, newspaper or magazine visual language, and art-directed collage posters. Do not select it from the generic word poster alone; require a clear editorial, publication, typographic, or art-directed poster context. Do not use it for image analysis, magazine articles, web magazine layouts, or complete brand identity systems.
generationContract: Return the final supplier-ready prompt as valid JSON text. It must fully specify subject, editorial composition, typography hierarchy, literal copy, palette, lighting, texture, print treatment, aspect ratio, and all must-change/must-preserve constraints. Do not wrap the JSON text in Markdown fences. For series delivery, provide one complete and distinct JSON-text prompt per output item.
